//about: Cline MCP Settings (Template) — Model Context Protocol server configurations.
//instructions: 1. Copy this file to your project root or Cline settings directory. 2. Configure each server's paths to match your environment. 3. Install the required MCP server packages. 4. For more info: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers

filesystem.//description: Filesystem server — provides read/write/list access to specified directories.
filesystem.//install: Install: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem OR use via npx.
filesystem.//note: List all directories you want Cline to access. Use absolute paths.

git.//description: Git server — provides git operations (status, log, diff, branch, commit).
git.//install: Install via pip: pip install mcp-server-git  OR  via npx: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-git
git.//note: Update the --repository path to point to your git repository or use --cwd for current directory.

fetch.//description: Fetch server — enables web page fetching so Cline can read URLs and web content.
fetch.//install: Install: pip install mcp-server-fetch  OR  use via uvx: uvx mcp-server-fetch

brave-search.//description: Web search server — uses the Brave Search API to perform web searches.
brave-search.//install: Install: pip install mcp-brave-search  OR  use via uvx: uvx mcp-brave-search
brave-search.//note: Requires a BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable. Sign up at https://brave.com/search/api.

postgres.//description: PostgreSQL server — provides database access for querying tables, schemas, and data.
postgres.//install: Install: pip install mcp-server-postgres  OR  use via uvx: uvx mcp-server-postgres
postgres.//note: Update the connection string with your database credentials. Ensure network access.

custom-server.//description: Placeholder for your custom MCP server.
custom-server.//note: Replace this entry with your actual server configuration.
custom-server.//config_command: command = executable or runtime (e.g., node, python, ./my-server)
custom-server.//config_args: args = arguments to pass to your server script
custom-server.//config_env: env = environment variables required by your server
